name: Terminations H1 2026
definition: Every employment separation with an effective date inside the engagement period, regardless of worker type or which system first observed it.

derivation_rule.rule_text: HRIS separation feed enumerates the membership (AUTHORITATIVE); Okta System Log deactivation events corroborate each member and contribute candidates observed in the IdP but absent from the feed.

exclusions.rationale: Separation converted to fixed-term advisory engagement; retained read-only access dispositioned under disp-2026-044.

name: Workforce roster (HRIS)
definition: All active and separated workers carried on the HRIS roster during the period — the identity anchor for every join on the lane.

derivation_rule.rule_text: All members enumerated by authoritative source hris.employee_feed (degenerate case).

name: IdP accounts (Okta)
definition: Every Okta account in the tenant — active, suspended, and deprovisioned — including service and integration identities.

derivation_rule.rule_text: Okta Users API enumerates the membership (AUTHORITATIVE); System Log lifecycle events corroborate status transitions.

name: Source-control accounts (GitHub)
definition: Every account with membership in the engineering org — SSO-linked and local — plus outside collaborators on production repositories.

derivation_rule.rule_text: Org members endpoint enumerates the membership; audit-log export contributes removal events and discovers accounts the members endpoint no longer returns.

name: Cloud IAM principals (GCP)
definition: Every principal holding an IAM binding at or below the production folder, with group-derived bindings expanded.

derivation_rule.rule_text: Cloud Asset Inventory IAM snapshot enumerates direct bindings (AUTHORITATIVE); group expansion is a contributing join pending google.groups capability.

name: Chat workspace users (Slack)
definition: Every Slack workspace user including single- and multi-channel guests.

derivation_rule.rule_text: SCIM Users enumerates full members (AUTHORITATIVE); guest coverage requires the audit-log surface, not yet ratified.

name: Identity join — workforce ↔ accounts
definition: The join of every in-scope account (Okta, GitHub, GCP, Slack) to exactly one canonical workforce identity on the HRIS roster.

derivation_rule.rule_text: HRIS roster anchors identity (AUTHORITATIVE); Okta profiles contribute employee_id and email joins; GitHub members are joined via SSO-linked login; accounts matching the service-identity rule are excluded by policy.

name: Everyone capable of modifying production
definition: The union of every principal that can change production: cloud IAM, source-control deploy paths, CI service accounts, and break-glass credentials.

derivation_rule.rule_text: Union of gcp.iam_policy bindings, github.org_members with deploy permission, and breakglass.config entries — the derivation cannot compile while breakglass.config has no ratified capability entry (E117).
